text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I can feel the tangible physical strengthening,
well-prepared to endure the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I give you my thanks, Master.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Even after returning home, I request training on par with, or even exceeding, that of the summer training camp.

—And so, the final summer training camp
with Mihono Bourbon came to an end.
